description: OSS corpus for false-positive measurement (docs/10 §10.2 ②). Pinned App Router examples authored by the Next.js team — code that is idiomatic by construction, so any finding here is either a real architectural issue or a bug in next-architect.

apps.why: Largest App Router example. Auth with server/client split — the boundary cases ARCH001-003 are built for.
Server SDK alongside client checkout components. Prime ARCH002 false-positive risk.
DB client in server code. ARCH002's server-oriented heuristics must stay silent here.
next/dynamic and lazy boundaries — reachability classification and ARCH004.
A client-only library that legitimately requires "use client". ARCH001 must not fire.
Plain multi-route App Router app with no data layer — the quiet baseline.
